## Basics

Before putting a “final touch” report on the study coordinator's desk, let's take a look at some of the basics of writing an industrial safety audit report. Meeting these criteria should at least get you into the ballpark. Then we can cover some of the specific writing techniques for toining up your report.

## Standards

An audit report should adhere to the same standards as any written document. The rules of good writing and indentical thesis support that we established when talking about your interview notes, also apply to the final report. Use proper grammar, write in complete sentences, and don't mix into a single paragraph more than one general theme or idea. The formatting of an audit report
